description: The delisting has no delisting return (DLRET). `triage()` adds this token to every delisting row whose dlret is still blank, so accepting its other flags never silently drops it.
action: Supply the missing value via --last-trade-closes, --merger-terms or --recoveries and rerun, or accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if no value exists to supply.

description: The security's history closes (not listed today, not sighted at the fails data's last day) and no rule gave it an ending, so the library wrote one of kind unknown (the spec's end-of-era branch 6: nothing found, no kind asserted), dated by the last day its own CUSIPs' fails rows show it trading, else MIDAS's last day of volume, else its last sighting. The date is a guess and is never published; the verdict is uncertain, and the row has no DLRET.
action: Find what ended it (a Form 25 under another CIK or class, a merger, a bankruptcy, a drop to the OTC market) in the issuer's filings and the fails rows; if the identity is wrong, pin the right cik/sec_id on the observations. Accept it only once you've confirmed the security really ended on about that day or is out of scope.

description: Neither a FIGI nor an issuer CIK was found for this ticker era, so its observations make no security.
action: Pin a cik or sec_id on the observations (or fix their ticker or name) and rerun; accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if the security is out of scope.

description: A Form 25 of the issuer whose class text names no recognized class, so it was matched to no security.
action: Read the Form 25 (accession in the reason); accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if it is not about this security, otherwise extend form25.class_kind for its class text.

description: The filing text dates the last trade differently from the date used (MIDAS volume, a Nasdaq halt, or the other filing).
action: Read the Form 25 notice or the 3.01 8-K to confirm the last trading day; supply its close in --last-trade-closes if the close is wrong, or accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if right.

description: No last-trade close was found in SEC fails-to-deliver data (or there is no last trade date), so the DLRET may be blank.
action: Matters when the row also carries no_dlret, or for a liquidation or compliance_failure delisting (their DLRET needs a close): supply the close in --last-trade-closes (sec_id,last_trade_close[,delist_date]). On an exchange transfer the DLRET is 0 whatever the close; accept it in bulk with `accept_review.py --flag no_last_close --bucket exchange_transfer`.

description: SEC fails-to-deliver data never shows this ticker near the era's first and last observation (the snapshot may carry a ticker adopted later).
action: Check which ticker the company traded under then and fix the observations, or accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if right.

description: The resolver found no issuer CIK for this ticker era by its ticker or name, so it inferred one from SEC fails-to-deliver CUSIP evidence (the issuer of an era sharing its CUSIP, shared_cusip, or of the new CUSIP its own switched to after a rename, cusip_handoff; the issuer code of its CUSIP, cusip_issuer) or from the ranking of 8-Ks naming the ticker (efts_frequency_renamed); the reason says which. Such an answer is never saved in the resolver cache.
action: Confirm the issuer named in the reason is the company that traded under the ticker then (its EDGAR names and filings around the era's dates); pin the right cik on the observations if it is wrong, or accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if right.

description: No source (MIDAS, a Nasdaq halt, the Form 25 notice or the 8-K text) dates the last trade.
action: Matters when the row also carries no_dlret, or for a liquidation or compliance_failure delisting (their DLRET needs a close): find the last trading day in the delisting filings and supply that day's close in --last-trade-closes. On an exchange transfer the DLRET is 0 whatever the close; accept it in bulk with `accept_review.py --flag no_last_trade_date --bucket exchange_transfer`.

description: No Form 25 was found, so the delisting was dated and classified from other filings (a bankruptcy or anchor 8-K, an SEC revocation or a Form 15).
action: Check the delisting date and bucket against the cited filing; accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if right.

description: The delisting is a Form 25 filed before the observations stopped: a stale snapshot kept listing a security already gone.
action: Confirm from the Form 25 and the deal filings that it really ended then; accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if right.

description: EDGAR's issuer name on the delisting date does not agree with the observed name, so the CIK may belong to another company.
action: Compare resolved_name with the observed name; pin the right cik on the observations if it is wrong, or accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if the company was renamed.

description: A merger whose consideration was never found or never passed the gate, so its DLRET was set to 0 (terminal value = last close).
action: Read the merger 8-K or proxy for the per-share consideration and supply it in --merger-terms; accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if 0% is right.

description: A merger row ruling R1 rewrote as a continuation (an exchange transfer to successor_sec_id): its terms were one share and no cash, the registrant's filings say each of its shares became one share of the successor, and the successor is a new issuer's or the same issuer's (sub-plan 5c); the reason keeps the old bucket and code.
action: Read the filing the delisting's evidence quotes: if holders received cash or another ratio, report it; otherwise accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if right.

description: No filing dated the delisting near the last observation, so delist_date is the last observation itself.
action: Look in the issuer's filings for the real end date; accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if the last observation is close.

description: LLM-read cash+stock merger terms were dropped: no acquirer ticker (no_acq_ticker), no acquirer price (no_acq_price), no last close (no_last_close), no number of shares to price (no_ratio), or cash plus stock at the acquirer's price is too far from the last close (fail_sanity).
action: Read the merger filing and supply cash_per_share, stock_ratio, acquirer_price and acquirer_ticker in --merger-terms.

description: A merger row the handoff pass rewrote as a continuation (an exchange transfer to the successor), on the successor issuer's own 8-K12B/8-K12G3; the reason keeps the old bucket and code.
action: Read the cited filing: if holders received something else than the successor's shares, report it; otherwise accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if right.

description: A Form 25 whose class could not be matched to exactly one of the issuer's securities.
action: Read the Form 25 (accession in the reason) to see which class it removed; accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if it is not about this security, otherwise pin the securities' sec_id.

description: A ticker era that reached a security only by its ticker or a name search was taken back out of it: merged in, it would have carried that security's range for the ticker across another security's CUSIP- or pin-confirmed range (the reason names both). The era was resolved again without that pick.
action: Check which security traded under the ticker over the era's dates; pin its sec_id or cik on the observations if the new answer is wrong, or accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if right.

description: The cash payout the regex read from the filing (the value after the colon) is more than the tolerance away from the last close, so it was not used.
action: Check the row's payout against the merger filing and supply the right terms in --merger-terms; accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if right.

description: The handoff pass found a continuation into another security of the run, but this delisting row says otherwise (a reconciled merger payout, a liquidation, or another successor) and was left as it is.
action: Read both securities' filings around the date and decide which is right; accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if the row is.

description: Merger terms the payout gate cannot check against the USD last close (sub-plan 5f): a cash leg in another currency (CAD: ruling R5, the library has no FX source), a basket of two or more securities (basket: ruling R3), or a stock leg stated as a dollar value over an averaging price (stock_value). The contract publishes the terms as read; the DLRET is a fill.
action: Price the terms (contract/price_requests.csv; convert a foreign cash leg yourself) or supply them in --merger-terms.

description: One ticker was observed under two or more names on the date after the colon; the reason names each name and the security it went to.
action: Check which company traded under the ticker that day and fix the other name's observation (its ticker, or a cik or sec_id pin), or accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if right.

description: A compliance-failure or liquidation delisting whose last close is $5 or more, so its distress bucket and negative DLRET may be wrong.
action: Read the Form 25 and the 8-Ks around it; supply a --recoveries ratio if the distress is real but the mark is not, or accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if right.

description: The LLM's cash (or cash-or-stock election) terms did not reconcile with the last close, so they were dropped.
action: Read the merger filing and supply the terms in --merger-terms; accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if right.

description: A confirmed Chapter 11 came long before the delisting and a change-in-control 8-K sits near it, so the merger rules classified it instead of the bankruptcy.
action: Confirm the company emerged and was then acquired, not liquidated; accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if right.

description: Another security of the run took over this security's ticker (an acquirer renamed into it), but this security has no delisting row to record that on (ticker_successor_sec_id).
action: Find how this security ended (its Form 25 or merger filing); accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if none exists.

description: An exchange-transfer delisting (CRSP code 304: filings continued more than 180 days after the delisting) whose successor security (successor_sec_id) was not found.
action: Confirm the security really moved -- to OTC or another venue -- and was not acquired or dropped for cause; if the bucket itself is wrong, no bucket override exists, so note it for a classifier rule instead of chasing the successor. Otherwise find the security the holders kept and add an observation of it; accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if none exists.

description: An 8-K tagged Item 1.03 (bankruptcy) never mentions a bankruptcy in its text, so the tag was ignored.
action: Read the 8-K (anchor_8k) to confirm it is not a bankruptcy; accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if right.

description: Delisted with no merger or distress evidence, so the bucket is unknown; DLRET is set to 0 at par only when a Form 25 or Form 15 also confirms deregistration and a last close exists, else it is blank.
action: Read the filings around the delisting to learn why it ended; accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if right, otherwise the classifier needs a rule.

description: The last close came from a fails-to-deliver row dated a few trading days late rather than the next trading day, so it may be an OTC or stale price.
action: Nothing unless the price looks off; supply the close in --last-trade-closes to override.

description: The issuer CIK came from SEC's current company_tickers.json, today's holder of the ticker.
action: Check resolved_name is the right company; if not, pin the cik on the observations.

description: No fails-to-deliver row followed the last trade, so the last close is an earlier one (the number after the colon is its age in trading days).
action: Nothing unless the price moved in those days; supply the close in --last-trade-closes to override.

description: The line follow (pipeline stage 4b) found the security trading on past its observations under a new CUSIP or ticker; the reason names the step, the filing that states it and what R2 made of it (the same security, a placeholder folded into a FIGI line, or a line continued by another FIGI).
action: Nothing unless the step looks wrong; read the filing the reason names, and pin the observations' sec_id if the new rows are another security's.

description: The last trade date came from filing text (or the last observation) that neither MIDAS volume nor a Nasdaq halt confirms.
action: Nothing unless the date looks off; the close is priced on it, so supply --last-trade-closes if needed.

description: OpenFIGI confirmed no US composite FIGI, so sec_id is a placeholder CIK<cik>-<CLASS>.
action: If the security had a FIGI, pin its sec_id or cusip on the observations; otherwise nothing to do.

description: A step of the security's line in the fails rows was not followed; after the colon, why (bankruptcy, otc_move, name, class, merged_out, other_registrant, read_failed, no_filing, unsettled, other_issuer, type, taken). The security's answer is the one it had without the step.
action: Nothing unless the security did go on under the new CUSIP or ticker as the same line; then pin the observations' sec_id.

description: The acquirer price in the merger's stock leg came from a fails-to-deliver row dated a few trading days late, so it may be an OTC or stale price.
action: Nothing unless the price looks off; supply acquirer_price in --merger-terms to override.

description: The handoff pass found that another security of the run took over this one's ticker as a continuation (a holding-company reorganization, redomicile, rename or reclassification: the holders' shares became the successor's one for one), so the row is an exchange transfer to successor_sec_id with a zero return; the reason gives the evidence (the successor issuer's 8-K12B/8-K12G3, or timing:cik / timing:cusip).
action: Nothing unless the successor is wrong: read the cited filing, or accept it in data/review_decisions.csv if right.

description: The registrant's filings state each share of the security became one share, with no cash (ruling R1), so the row is an exchange transfer to successor_sec_id with a zero return (sub-plan 5c).
action: Nothing unless the filing says holders were paid or got another ratio; then the row is a merger.

description: The CIK came from the observations' cik pin although EDGAR's name disagrees (it sits beside member_name_mismatch).
action: Nothing if the pin is right; otherwise correct the cik pin in the observations.

description: A drop no filing documents: the issuer has no SEC filing around the last day SEC MIDAS shows exchange volume (a bank that filed with the FDIC), and the security's own CUSIPs traded on over the counter after it. The last trade is that MIDAS day (CRSP 500, reason unavailable).
action: Nothing to do unless the date or the kind looks wrong; read the receivership or delisting notice.

description: An unknown delisting at the security's own CUSIP switch is an exchange transfer to its line successor: the line follow (stage 4b) found the new CUSIP trading on as a FIGI of its own (R2), and the reason names the filing that states the step.
action: Nothing unless the filing says holders were paid or got another ratio; then the row is a merger.
